summary: Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co. filed an 8-K announcing a press release from target Forge Nano, Inc. about a strategic partnership with Samsung SDI. This is a de-SPAC business combination originally disclosed in a merger agreement dated April 20, 2026. Terms remain as filed in the S-4 registration statement; no specific price-per-share or premium is restated here. The SPAC's board has not issued a new recommendation in this filing; prior S-4 details apply. The transaction requires shareholder vote at an extraordinary general meeting, SEC registration effectiveness, and regulatory clearances. Watch for shareholder approval and potential redemption risk.
